readme:
Dungeon Hunter II reconstruction — v21.3 (Windows x64)

Play.cmd opens the main menu. Play-swamp.cmd starts the Swamp directly.
Development preview: see package-receipt.json for acceptance and executable hash, and release-notes.json for verified fixes and remaining issues.

Keep this folder separate from previous releases. Saved progress is copied separately after acceptance; no saves belong to the frozen package manifest. Previous packages and original saves are preserved.

Controls
WASD: run. Shift: walk. Space: context action/basic attacks. Tab: select target.
1/2/3: skills from left to right. 4: selected Faery skill. 5: potion.
E: confirm displayed travel destination. C or portrait: character pages.
Escape: pause/resume. Enter or SKIP: skip cinematics; caption click advances dialogue.
Death: click or press Space to Continue and restore the checkpoint.
F5/F9: gameplay checkpoint save/load; active actions can reject checkpoints.
Merchant lists: wheel, Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown or vertical drag.
Drop and Transmute ask for confirmation before acting.

Remaining preview limitations
- Fire remains sharper and more patterned than the original video; the user accepted this caveat.
- Broad water caustics and fog/lighting still differ; full visual parity is not claimed.
- Repeated F9 after restoring a dead monster can reject a mutable targeting flag; that earlier preview caveat is retained.
- Broader RoomZone, class/skill/passive and companion/later-act content remains partial.
- Authentic audio callbacks, voices and nonzero device-bound PCM were verified; acoustic parity was not checked by ear. Source focus-in and conditional unreached audio paths remain documented.

The original video is v1.0.3; recovered source/assets include v1.0.2 and iPad v1.0.0 evidence. Unknown version differences are recorded in the reports.

Includes the prior v21.1 chest-crash and v21.2 main-menu Continue hotfixes.
